title: Find the running preview
responsibility: Reads the existing preview address and refuses a different checkout or history source.

inputs.name: previewOwner.port
inputs.description: Loopback port used to reserve the one preview slot.

inputs.name: previewOwner.identity
inputs.description: Fingerprint of the checkout and selected history data.

outputs.name: previewOwnerPort
outputs.description: Releases only this process’s preview and ownership listener; a reusing process leaves the owner running.

outputs.name: previewOwnerPath
outputs.description: Releases only this process’s preview and ownership listener; a reusing process leaves the owner running.

outputs.name: previewOwner
outputs.description: Address of a matching, ready preview.
